pages.text: Saint Paul wrote a letter to a church. He said, "Love is patient. Love is kind. Love is not jealous or proud or rude."
"Love does not keep a list of wrongs. Love is happy with the truth. Love never gives up and always hopes."
"Faith, hope and love will last. And the greatest of these is love." God is love, and He teaches us to love one another.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Love is patient and kind. Jesus teaches us to love God and to love one another.
